mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the potatoes was most worthwhile: the substantial yield made the earlier planting and survival of the farm feel consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading and then heating the pot in two separate stages felt a little repetitive, although the sequence was clear.

surprise.text: The potatoes were already washed and cut when harvested, making that single action more comprehensive than I expected.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the cloth catching the shelled beans was initially uncertain but made practical sense once explained.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens to the specimens and the return journey. The harvest provided a satisfying payoff, though the largely linear cooking sequence offered few meaningful choices.
